description: IMAGE-PREWARM-B2 (docs/operations/aws.md 22.9): how many code bundles of authoring heads have a standby at once, one Fargate Spot task per role each (runner + service, about US$ 29/month at saturation for 1). Over it the newest push wins: the oldest bundle's standbys stop and its branches fall back to the slow path (a log line). 0 starts no standby. Raising it is new spend, Daniel's decision (budget US$ 60/month).
